question: In Table 1D-2, how is 'Road Work' abbreviated on a portable changeable message sign, and what may follow it?
model_answer: Direct Answer: In Table 1D-2, "Road Work" is abbreviated as **RD WK** on a portable changeable message sign. The table lists a prompt word that follows the abbreviation — "Ahead" or a [Distance] — with the example "RD WK 1 MILE." Use of these abbreviations is mandatory when the listed word messages need to be abbreviated on a portable changeable message sign, and the prompt word should accompany the abbreviation. Standards (mandatory): - "When the word messages shown in Table 1D-2 need to be abbreviated on a portable changeable message sign, the abbreviations shown in Table 1D-2 shall be used. Unless indicated by an asterisk, these abbreviations shall only be used on portable changeable message signs." Guidance (recommended): - "The abbreviations for the words listed in Table 1D-2 that also show a prompt word should not be used on a portable changeable message sign... unless the prompt word shown in Table 1D-2 either precedes or follows the abbreviation, as applicable." For RD WK, the prompt word "Ahead" or a [Distance] follows the abbreviation. Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows the Table 1D-2 row for "Road Work" with standard abbreviation "RD WK," prompt word following the abbreviation "Ahead, [Distance]," and example "RD WK 1 MILE." [Image 2] (Page 77) presents the same Table 1D-2 (Sheet 1 of 2) row confirming RD WK with the following prompt words "Ahead, [Distance]." [Image 3] (Page 78) shows Sheet 2 of Table 1D-2 and does not contain the Road Work entry. [Image 4] (Page 559) shows Table 2L-4 message-construction examples, including condensing ROAD and WORK per Table 1D-2 (e.g., "ROADWORK NEXT 3 MILES"). [Image 5] (Page 873) shows Section 6L.05 text requiring that abbreviations on portable changeable message signs follow Section 1D.08. Citations: - Section 1D.08 Standard §2 (p.34) - Section 1D.08 Guidance §3 (p.34) - Table 1D-2 (p.36) - Page 77
